capabilities: read-it-later | Saves web pages you submit, extracts the article text and keeps it for reading later in a web interface, with tags, search, annotations and a REST API.
article-export | Exports saved articles as EPUB, PDF, CSV, JSON, XML or plain text files.
description:
UnitySVC runs the official wallabag image in a separate container for each enrollment, with its own HTTPS address. wallabag is a self-hosted read-it-later application: give it the address of a web page and it fetches the page, extracts the article and keeps a clean copy you can read later. Articles can be tagged (by hand or by rules), starred, archived, searched and annotated, exported as EPUB or PDF, and followed as feeds. It has a REST API, used by wallabag's browser extension and mobile apps, and it imports from Pocket, Instapaper, Pinboard and other services. Everything is kept in the instance's own SQLite database, stored in the `wallabag` folder of your home, so it survives stopping the instance and even removing it and enrolling again.

Enroll in the base channel and keep or replace the generated password. Sign in at `https://<instance>/` as `wallabag` with that password, then save your first article with the + button. Public registration is off, so the instance has the one account unless you add more yourself. The instance works without knowing its own address; an optional parameter gives it the address for the few places that print it. You can run one wallabag instance at a time. See How to use this service for full setup and limitations.

You pay the selected channel's platform compute cost while the instance runs, including idle time, and the platform keeps the data in your home while it is stopped. Labs adds no markup and receives no seller payout. See the upstream wallabag documentation and issue tracker for software-specific help.

base.description: One private wallabag instance; its data is kept in the wallabag folder of your home between runs and enrollments.

SYMFONY__ENV__DOMAIN_NAME.description: Optional. Leave `//` and wallabag links its pages and files relative to whatever address you open it at, which works at any instance address. Only a few places then lack the full address: the feed identifiers, the Android app link and QR code on the Config page and the examples on the API how-to page. To have them show it, enter this instance's address, for example https://abc123.example.app (shown in the enrollment's instance details), with no trailing slash, and save; changing it restarts the instance and keeps your data. A wrong address here breaks the page styling, so set it back to `//` if the pages look unstyled.
SYMFONY__ENV__DOMAIN_NAME.title: Instance address (optional)

SYMFONY__ENV__SECRET.description: Generated for this enrollment; wallabag uses it to sign sessions, forms and remember-me cookies, in place of the image's built-in default that is the same everywhere. You do not need to type it anywhere. Changing it signs everyone out. Save it now: the platform keeps it as a secret and does not show it again.
SYMFONY__ENV__SECRET.title: Application secret

WALLABAG_PASSWORD.description: Generated for this enrollment; keep it or enter your own. It becomes the password of the `wallabag` account only when wallabag first creates its database: your data lives in your home, so if the database already exists (an earlier enrollment, or a later restart) this value is ignored and the existing password still applies. Change the password on wallabag's own Config page. Save it now: the platform keeps it as a secret and does not show it again.
WALLABAG_PASSWORD.title: Password of the wallabag account
